title: ALPINE: Adaptive Localization for Parameter- and Sample-Efficient Few-Shot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-shot learning research is predominantly evaluated on accuracy alone, with limited attention to the parameter and training-sample budgets required to reach that accuracy - a real constraint for practitioners without large-scale compute. We present an ultra-lightweight (22,249-34,917 parameter) spatial-relational architecture for few-shot image classification that combines fixed Gabor edge-energy guidance with a windowed, content-adaptive patch locator. Under a strictly matched, iso-episode-budget protocol (250 meta-training episodes, 5 canonical seeds, 600 evaluation episodes per seed), our architecture achieves 5-shot accuracy gains, consistent across all five seeds, over Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML on both CIFAR-FS and MiniImageNet, while using 27-53% fewer parameters than any baseline. translated_title: ALPINE：面向参数与样本高效少样本学习的自适应定位方法
translated_abstract: 少样本学习研究目前主要以准确率作为评价指标，而对达到该准确率所需的参数量和训练样本预算关注甚少——对于缺乏大规模计算资源的从业者而言，这是一个现实的约束。我们提出了一种用于少样本图像分类的超轻量级（22,249-34,917 参数）空间-关系架构，该架构将固定的 Gabor 边缘能量引导与基于窗口的、内容自适应的补丁定位器相结合。在严格匹配的等回合预算协议下（250 个元训练回合、5 个标准随机种子、每个种子 600 个评估回合），我们的架构在 CIFAR-FS 和 MiniImageNet 两个数据集上均取得了 5-shot 准确率的提升，且在全部五个种子上保持一致，超越了原型网络、关系网络和 MAML，同时参数量比任何基线少 27-53%。此外，它还能在更少的训练回合内收敛，并对未见过的细粒度领域（CUB-200-2011 鸟类数据集，零……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了一种仅含约2.2万至3.5万参数的超轻量少样本图像分类架构ALPINE，通过结合Gabor边缘能量引导与内容自适应的补丁定位器，在参数量比基线少27-53%且训练回合更少的情况下，于CIFAR-FS和MiniImageNet上稳定超越原型网络、关系网络和MAML。
en_tdlr: ALPINE is an ultra-lightweight (22K-35K parameter) few-shot image classification architecture combining fixed Gabor edge-energy guidance with a content-adaptive patch locator, achieving consistent 5-shot accuracy gains over Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML on CIFAR-FS and MiniImageNet while using 27-53% fewer parameters and converging in fewer training episodes.
